answer: Control rods drop on loss of power; the safe state needs no action. Build sybil defence the same way. A new key earns nothing by default, and rewards unlock only after several epochs of independent passes. If evidence of linkage appears, payouts freeze automatically until cleared. The burden sits on the identity, not the network. Cloning keys then buys a ledge of frozen balances, an umber stain on the record, and a fable of easy profit nobody collects.
